sections.label: Full Body
sections.description:
Looking for a fully shaded piece of your character(s)? This option is for you!
  • +$45 for each additional character in the piece
  • Weapons/props can be included for a variable additional charge, based on complexity.
  • Background is transparent by default, but simple or complex backgrounds can be added for an additional charge.

sections.label: Character Reference
sections.description:
If your character needs a new reference sheet or needs to be drawn for the first time, this is the option for you.
  • Can be done from text descriptions or random images.
  • Options for alternate forms, extra outfits, or other props are available for a variable extra charge.
  • For free, you can add a color palette, a SFW base version, or a height chart.

sections.label: D&D Party Token
sections.description:
A token of your whole adventuring party for your online TTRPG games. Best used for tracking your party's progress on overworld maps, or just shoving your characters into a tiny circle!
  • An additional charge may be added for larger parties or added complexity.
  • VTT-ready token with border can be added for free upon request.
.

sections.label: Sketch
sections.description:
My clean and detailed sketches are a quicker and cheaper option if you're looking for character art.
  • Sketches are not colored, but are allowed to be colored as long as credit is given.
  • Light shading can be added for free upon request.
